subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Which narrower follow-ups should own the remaining systemd SecretRef, update diff/safe-update, token doctor guidance, and self-healing audit scope from #97971?
rationale: Current main already covers part of the request, while the remaining pieces affect stable security, auth, update, systemd, and audit contracts that automation should not combine or productize without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split Remaining Work
options.body: Keep this umbrella open only long enough to file or link focused issues for the remaining docs, update UX, doctor guidance, and audit semantics, then close the umbrella when ownership is clear.

options.title: Route To Existing Canonicals
options.body: Close covered subrequests and attach the remaining evidence to existing issues such as SecretRef consistency, systemd service provenance, update config reverts, and doctor diff mode.

options.title: Sponsor Unified Design
options.body: Treat this as a larger design task for a managed Linux deployment/update/audit workflow before accepting implementation PRs.

recommendation.title: Split Remaining Work
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella open only long enough to file or link focused issues for the remaining docs, update UX, doctor guidance, and audit semantics, then close the umbrella when ownership is clear.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest sampled history across the update/gateway CLI surfaces where most remaining decisions converge.
